Kevin — thanks for the packet capture and the quick heads up. Short summary from our side (initial):
- At 07:57 PDT we deployed a small control-plane config change to improve conntrack handling for long-lived streams in private deployments.
- Within 1–2 minutes post-deploy, our telemetry showed transient leader election delays on the control-plane replica set that manages routing for cp-clinic-01. That caused the API gateway to return 502 for inflight requests until the leader election completed (~10–12 minutes).

Immediate mitigation we performed at 08:07 PDT: rolled back the control-plane change for clusters pinned to the older conntrack profile; this restored normal leader election timing and traffic. We've kept your cluster on the pinned config and are continuing to monitor.

- Engineering is collecting debug logs from the control-plane nodes and cross-referencing with your pcap and request IDs. (see attached redwood_debug_log_0914.txt)
